annotations.title: Add or remove the AI-content declaration on Snapchat media

description: Add or remove Snapchat's AI-content self-declaration (ai_content_source USER_AI_GEN) on media already uploaded to the ad account. declared:true adds it, false removes it. The reply is what Snapchat stored, read back. A SNAP_AI_GENERATED mark from Snapchat's own AI tools can only be changed by Snapchat. upload_snapchat_ads_creative already declares a Hermoso render when it uploads it. Free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

declared.description: true adds the declaration, false removes it
